feedback: All test cases directly and adequately cover the requirement to accept expressions with or without spaces between numbers and operators. Test R007-T01 validates non-spaced expressions (e.g., '2+3'), R007-T02 validates spaced expressions (e.g., '2 + 3'), and R007-T03 extends coverage to multiple consecutive operators without spaces, ensuring robust parsing under the left-to-right evaluation rule for same-precedence operators. The test plan justifies scope, coverage, and alignment with customer intent. No additional tests are needed to validate this specific requirement, as the provided cases fully satisfy the stated interface and intent. Mathematical reference checks are not required here as no numeric computation is disputed. Coverage is complete and justified.
